interpretation.normal_basis: Layer editing stores the decoded normal before the SoC shader's final z *= 0.5. Rendered angular errors include that scale once.
interpretation.gloss: The shader uses bump.r squared. UI layer gloss is linear and packing takes its square root.
interpretation.height: Parallax uses bumpX alpha. RGB stores normal residuals, not RGB height.
interpretation.residual: SDK emits 128 + 2*error/3. Material Lab uses full residual because actual double-BC3 encode/decode gives lower angular error on this fixture with its encoder. The format matches; output is not bit-identical to SDK conversion.
interpretation.checks: No-op preview and gloss-only normal channels must change exactly zero bytes. Unchanged raw DDS export must be byte exact. Angular/RMSE metrics describe this fixture; they are not guarantees for arbitrary textures.
interpretation.limitations: Edited DDS export is lossy BC3. No-op byte preservation applies to raw original DDS export; edited files and their derived mipmaps are recompressed.
